$comment: Single source for the six Seelensplitter figures (order SZ-001..SZ-006). Accent colours from docs/visual-konzept/KONZEPT.md B4, all >= 4.5:1 (AA) as text: 'dark' on #0B0B10, 'light' on #F6F4EF (checked by scripts/ci/check-contrast.mjs). 'media' colours may only be used inside that figure's own medium (e.g. Gl1tch's terminal), never as UI accent. Portraits: character sheets from the Notion pages Lore / Charaktere (signature pose = portrait, page cover = scene). Plain JSON so seez-kit and the Videothek can read the same values later.
